cases.purpose: In a headless session a missing shader file, a file containing a NUL byte, an over-1-MiB file, a valid file with no render node, and render without a shader each fail with status 1 and a diagnostic naming the cause, while the canvas stays exactly as drawn (compared with an independent PPM model) and the session continues to work.
cases.oracle: Independent PPM byte model of the red 4x4 canvas; errno texts per the documented gpu shader behaviour (fopen failure, EINVAL for invalid/oversize text, 'no usable render node' when no DRM render node exists).
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.
cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
e() { local l=$1 want=$2; local m=$(< err.txt); [[ $m == *"$want"* ]] && echo yes || echo "no [$m]"; }
gpu start 4 4 --headless; echo "start=$?"
gpu rect 0 0 4 4 FF0000; echo "rect=$?"
gpu shader "$PWD/nosuch.frag" 2>err.txt; echo "missing-file status=$? names-error=$(e x 'No such file or directory')"
printf 'void main(){}\0\n' > nul.frag
gpu shader "$PWD/nul.frag" 2>err.txt; echo "nul-byte-file status=$? names-error=$(e x 'Invalid argument')"
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'open("big.frag","wb").write(b"a" * (1024 * 1024 + 1))'
gpu shader "$PWD/big.frag" 2>err.txt; echo "oversize-file status=$? names-error=$(e x 'Invalid argument')"
printf 'precision mediump float;\nvoid main(){gl_FragColor=vec4(1.0);}\n' > ok.frag
gpu shader "$PWD/ok.frag" 2>err.txt; echo "valid-shader-without-gpu status=$? reports-no-render-node=$(e x 'no usable render node')"
gpu render 0.0 2>err.txt; echo "render-without-shader status=$? says-load-first=$(e x 'load a fragment shader first')"
gpu save out.ppm ppm; echo "save=$?"
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if open("out.ppm","rb").read() == b"P6\n4 4\n255\n" + bytes([255,0,0]) * 16 else 1)'; echo "canvas-unchanged-matches-model=$([[ $? == 0 ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
gpu shader off; echo "shader-off=$?"
gpu stop; echo "stop=$?"
cases.stdout:
start=0
rect=0
missing-file status=1 names-error=yes
nul-byte-file status=1 names-error=yes
oversize-file status=1 names-error=yes
valid-shader-without-gpu status=1 reports-no-render-node=yes
render-without-shader status=1 says-load-first=yes
save=0
canvas-unchanged-matches-model=yes
shader-off=0
stop=0
